summary.text: Shannon Dicely is the Democratic candidate for the Texas State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Dennis Paul.

paragraphs.text: Shannon Dicely defeated Cameron Rollwitz in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for District 11.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, she listed affordability, public education and healthcare as her three key campaign messages.
She said she supports raising the minimum wage, raising the per-student school funding allotment and teacher pay, and expanding Medicaid.
